title: Bohr's Last Problem Under the Entirety Hypothesis: A Survey with Initial Reductions
summary: Bohr's last problem (1952) asks whether every ordinary Dirichlet series with nonzero Lindelöf order function $μ$ has $μ'(ω_μ{-}0)\le-1$; a negative answer would imply Lindelöf for $ζ$. Kahane (1989) refuted this with half-plane counterexamples. We study the refinement for series with entire continuation of order $\le 1$: the Analytic Lindelöf Hypothesis that $μ$ is piecewise linear with integer slopes.
